title: session-load's live mode classes kbtail and a bare kbmon.py as other when ps shows the interpreter as Python
goal: bench_load.live_class matches the interpreter name without regard to case, so a framework or Homebrew Python (.../Python.app/Contents/MacOS/Python) running kbtail.py or kbmon.py gets the kbtail and kbmon classes

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_load as b
P = '/opt/homebrew/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/Resources/Python.app/Contents/MacOS/Python'
assert b.live_class(P + ' _tools/kbtail.py --follow', b.HOME) == 'kbtail', b.live_class(P + ' _tools/kbtail.py --follow', b.HOME)

notes: Review gap 5 of SP-wv3ob5vy: bench_load.py:724 re.fullmatch(r'python[\d.]*', words[0]) is case-sensitive.
